ios.desc:
Elephant Folio is a PDF organizer built for people who read a lot of PDFs.

Bring a paper in from Safari, Mail, or anywhere on your device, and Elephant Folio files it for you; based on what's inside of it, not just the filename. The folders get made. The tags get applied. You keep reading.

Rules that organize for you
Set a rule once and every matching document gets tagged automatically. Match on filename, file contents, author, and more. Rules run the moment a file arrives, and you can re-run them on any file in your whole library anytime. No more tagging one file at a time.

Smart organizing, on by default
When Apple Intelligence is available on one of your devices, Elephant Folio can also read and tag documents on its own. 

Your documents stay yours
Everything stays on your devices. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

Capture from anywhere
The Share extension works across Safari, Mail, Files, and anything else that can hand off a PDF. Scan a physical page and it's filed before you put your phone down and your rules apply instantly.

Search that actually reaches
Not just filenames. Not just folders. Text, tags, and document content, so the thing you're looking for turns up even when you don't remember what you called it.

One library across all your devices
iCloud keeps Mac, iPad, and iPhone in sync — down to the exact page you left off on. Files live in your Documents folder and open in any app that reads PDFs. Siri Shortcuts let Elephant Folio fit inside whatever system you've already built for yourself.

Import from anywhere (even from the browser on a Windows): 
As long as you can access your iCloud folder, you can drag your PDF documents to Elephant Folio and they will be imported next time you open the app.

No internet? No problem
Elephant Folio is a privacy-centric, offline-first app. Capture, read, tag, and search anywhere. 
The only network requests this app makes are ones to Apple's servers for iCloud syncing or those to fetch metadata from CrossRef/ArXiv/Pubmed. 

The elephant never forgets. Now neither do you.

By using this app you agree to Apple's standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

quotes.text:
Hey! 
I accumulate a lot of PDFs that I want to read, but never get back to them, and have no way of organizing them, so I built Elephant Folio.

Elephant Folio will organize your PDFs, suggest better filenames, index them and tag them; all on-device. Additionally, it features a Safari extension, so you can import PDFs you find from HN straight into Elephant Folio's library, or anywhere else you get your PDFs.

Let me know what you think!
